_comment: SB3 profile: Air role, camp mode, Nashville airband on RTL NESDR SMArTee v5 serial 95339533 (reprogrammed from factory 00000001 on 2026-07-19; replaced the flaky Blog V4 83241970) -> neptune-air.mp3. NOTE on log2_decim: the Phase 2 brief's example carried log2_decim=4, which delivers a 2048000/2^4 = 128 kHz baseband window. The four channels span 118.400-119.450 MHz = 1.05 MHz around center 118.925, i.e. +/-525 kHz, which does NOT fit in a 128 kHz window. log2_decim is 0 here so the full 2.048 MHz (half-window +/-1.024 MHz) holds all four channels, matching the proven macos/bin/sdrangel-restore.py RTL recipe. The validator (sb3/profile.py, profile-channel-outside-baseband) rejects the log2_decim=4 form for exactly this reason.
name: air.airband.nashville
